I unlocked him, but it won't be useful because I covered multiple options.
My main focus was on making him draw a shitton of cards, so i played with Team Leader Tachyon, Argent Adept, Tempest (of course), Omnitron and Nightmist
Incapped through self damage and friendly fire (kill shot went to omnitron-X).
Had entire deck in hand or in play by the end, and played all three draw cards at least once. One Localized Hurricane in play, as well as a bunc h of other things including electrical storm (though i destroyed it later), genebound shackles and otheworldly resistance (also destroyed), and vicious cyclone.

Incap powers were never used, though. So there is that down.

Current theory is either: 

Lose a game to Iron Legacy with regular Tempest on the team. Then, defeat any villain with regular Tempest and without a legacy on the team. Tempest must be the only hero incapacitated, and he must have shuffled his deck at least once.

OR

Lose a game to Iron Legacy with regular Tempest on the team. Then, defeat any villain with regular Tempest and without a legacy on the team. Tempest must be the only hero incapacitated, and he must have drawn at least 10* cards other than normal draw.

OR BOTH:

Lose a game to Iron Legacy with regular Tempest on the team. Then, defeat any villain with regular Tempest and without a legacy on the team. Tempest must be the only hero incapacitated; he must have drawn at least 10* cards other than normal draw and have shuffled his deck at least once.

*I'm not sure what number this is. 10 was suggested before and not disproved, as far as I know

EDIT: posts on steam indicate shuffling the trash is not required. So final hyothesis is the second one.
